# Contact directory — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the contact directory when the task is finding a person: a docked search over grouped contact rows with an empty-state recovery. `contacts` plus the query trio is the whole contract — grouping and filtering run through the shared pure helpers, matching name and detail case-insensitively, so what the eye filters is what the announcement filters. Choosing is reported through `onSelect` while keeping is the host's: there is no directory-owned selection, and no command-palette search either, because the directory search is docked and never modal. The default English strings — search label, placeholder, empty title and description — are all overridable props, so the recovery speaks the host's language.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the contact directory when the task is finding a person: an inline search over grouped contact rows with an empty-state recovery — the native twin under the same contract. `contacts` plus the query trio is the whole contract — grouping and filtering run through the shared pure helpers, matching name and detail case-insensitively, so what the eye filters is what the announcement filters. Choosing is reported through `onSelect` while keeping is the host's: there is no directory-owned selection, and no command-palette search either, because the directory search is inline and never a modal palette. The default English strings — search label, placeholder, empty title and description — are all overridable props, and the search, the groups and the recovery announce as one labelled unit.
